title: Source Specification v1
description: Extraction specification for an InfoSource. Each InfoSource holds a source_specs list; all specs are evaluated against the same fetch group (the InfoSource URL's fetched bytes, not chained off primary extracted output). The first spec is the primary extraction strategy; additional specs are cross-check alternatives for selector-rot detection. All specs in a list must share a content-kind family (html_text: css|xpath|regex|full_page; json: jsonpath). The URL is a separate InfoSource field, not part of this spec.
